issues.issue: Was the procedural fairness letter sent before the refusal decisions sufficiently specific to alert the parents to the officer's misrepresentation concerns?
issues.applicant_position: Letter was too vague to show the source of concerns (confession letters), so parents could not answer.
issues.respondent_position: Letter gave sufficient notice of concerns; no duty to name the source; any defect was cured by later disclosure.
issues.result_text: Weldesenbet reasoning applies; any prior procedural fairness breach was remedied on reconsideration.

issues.issue: Did the reconsideration decisions breach procedural fairness by making an adverse credibility finding without a chance to respond?
issues.applicant_position: Officer made an adverse credibility finding without affording an opportunity to respond, breaching fairness.
issues.respondent_position: Officer's reasoning turned on sufficiency of evidence, so no fairness duty arose; Alalami is determinative.
issues.result_text: Assuming an adverse credibility finding, fairness did not require a further chance to respond.
